_comment: Example strix-alloy configuration. Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\strix-alloy\config.json and edit the paths for your machine. The launcher's -Action configure writes this for you.

_notes.modelDir: Folder holding the target GGUF shards. The launcher starts the first shard; it validates that the -of-NNNNN set is complete.
_notes.draftPath: Optional. The shared Q8_0 MTP sidecar enables speculative decoding. Leave empty (or the file absent) to run the serial profile. The launcher never switches mode silently and logs which profile ran.
_notes.port: Local port. Bound to 127.0.0.1 only; no firewall rule is created.
_notes.contextSize: Context window. 32768 is a safe starting point; the tested maximum is 251904.
_notes.ubatch: Micro-batch for prefill. 2048 is the conservative default; 16384 is used for the published prefill numbers and needs a large GPU carve.
